blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—With basically a new core, it would be easy to count out National University in Season 89 of the UAAP men’s basketball tournament. Jake Figueroa, Steve Nash Enriquez and Jolo Manansala have all graduated, but Reinhard Jumamoy is leading this current pack of Bulldogs who are ready to prove themselves as worthy successors of the celebrated trio that made National U a perennial title contender. “Us being young and losing a lot of our previous players are not reasons anymore at this point,” he said in Filipino after National U’s […]...
